Package index

Creating a project

The project holds the paper; everything below builds it.

create_paper()
Create a reproducible Quarto manuscript project
create_example_paper()
Create an example project: a small study, written as an easypaper paper
affiliations()
The affiliations of the manuscript, under the authors

Rendering

Documents to read, written into output/. Every render checks the project first, sets the scientific names of the references in italics, and copies the figures to PNG, JPEG and TIFF at 600 dpi.

render_docx() render_pdf() render_html() render_supplementary() render_all() preview()
Render the manuscript
export_code()
Write the analysis code as one script
export_figure_formats()
Copy every figure to JPEG and TIFF at 600 dpi
clean_cache()
Clear the knitr cache

Submitting

What you send, built into submission/: the manuscript split for double-blind review, the supplement, the figures, and the data and code compendium.

make_preprint()
Build a preprint deposit
make_submission()
Build the folder you send to a journal

Checking

What every render verifies first, to call on its own.

check_citations() check_crossrefs() check_packages() check_title() check_data() check_renv()
Check a project before rendering it
check_species()
Which scientific names of the references go in italics
check_species_text()
Check the scientific names in the text
manuscript_stats()
A summary of the manuscript

Data and metadata

data/ is the folder that publishes. convert_data() brings originals in, in a format that will still open in twenty years; the deposit’s metadata is filled in from what the project already knows.

convert_data()
Convert or copy originals into the project's data folder
deposit_zenodo()
Reserve the DOI of the data deposit on Zenodo
sync_metadata()
Fill in what the data deposit's metadata can know by itself
edit_metadata()
Describe the data deposit by hand
sync_licenses()
Copy the authors into the licences

Journals and references

Any journal’s citation style, fetched from the official CSL repository into references/; and the scientific names of any bibliography in italics.

list_journals()
The journals a project can render for
add_journal()
Add a journal's citation style to the project
italicize_species()
Set the scientific names of a bibliography in italics

Co-authors in Google Docs

td_upload() td_update() td_download()
Edit a section with co-authors in Google Docs

easypaper easypaper-package
easypaper: automate reproducible Quarto manuscripts from draft to submission
